name: incidentio
description: Connect incident.io to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use incident.io MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect incident.io to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with incidents and on-call using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my incident.io workspace.
Find anything in incident.io that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review incidents and on-call in incident.io.
